description: Save the full custom prompt from the prompt studio: when non-empty it replaces the built-in instructions for interview answers or exam answers; an empty string goes back to the built-in style plus extra requirements. baseline records which official text this prompt was derived from for future official-update merges: if you started from a text in get_prompt_presets pass that one (official / current / style:<value>), after a sync rewrite pass official, for a prompt written from scratch pass none, and omit it for small edits to keep the existing record. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)

lang.description: Interview language this prompt is for; defaults to the saved one

prompt.description: Full prompt; empty string = stop customizing

name: save_custom_prompt
